scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace=@clawr/cir && npm run build --workspace=@clawr/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@clawr/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@clawr/runtime && npm run build:prepared
scripts.build:prepared: tsc --noEmit && npm run copy:runtime && npm run build:rwrc
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build --workspace=@clawr/runtime && npm run copy:runtime
scripts.copy:runtime: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/include && cp -R ../runtime/dist/include dist/include && cp ../runtime/dist/libClawr.* dist/
scripts.build:rwrc: ttsc && bun build ./dist/src/index.js --compile --outfile dist/rwrc && node scripts/sign-rwrc.mjs
